description_en: Adds a log ingestion task to import the corresponding log data into Threat Analysis for subsequent alerting and event analysis
description_zh: 添加日志接入任务，将对应的日志数据接入到威胁分析中以便后续的告警、事件分析
name: AddUserSourceLogConfig

parameters.help_en: The Alibaba Cloud account ID for which logs are to be ingested
parameters.help_zh: 需要接入日志的阿里云账号ID
parameters.name: sub_user_id

parameters.help_en: The detailed Simple Log Service (SLS) information for the logs to be ingested, in JSON format
parameters.help_zh: 需要接入日志的详细SLS信息，json格式
parameters.name: source_log_info

parameters.help_en: The detailed Simple Log Service (SLS) information for the logs to be ingested
parameters.help_zh: 需要接入日志的详细SLS信息
parameters.name: dis_play_line

parameters.help_en:
Specifies whether to add or delete the ingestion task. Valid values:
-1: Deletes the ingestion task.
0: Adds the ingestion task
parameters.help_zh:
添加接入或删除接入。取值：
-1：删除接入
0：添加接入
parameters.name: deleted

parameters.help_en:
The region where the data management center of Threat Analysis is located. You must select the region of the management center based on the region where your assets are located. Valid values:
cn-hangzhou: Assets are located in the Chinese mainland and Hong Kong (China).
ap-southeast-1: Assets are located outside China
parameters.help_zh:
威胁分析的数据管理中心所在地。您需要根据资产所在地域，选择管理中心所在地。取值：
cn-hangzhou：资产属于中国内地与中国香港
ap-southeast-1：资产属于海外地域
parameters.name: region_id
